changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: if not exists (select * from sys.objects where object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[DatabaseServer]') and type in (N'U')) begin create table [dbo].[DatabaseServer] ( [ID] [int] identity(1,1) NOT NULL, [Server] [varchar](250) NOT NULL, [Username] [varchar](25) NOT NULL, [Password] [varchar](50) MASKED WITH (FUNCTION = 'default()') NOT NULL, [SearchServer] [varchar](250) NULL, [EventTopic] [varchar](250) CONSTRAINT [DF_DatabaseServer_EventTopic] DEFAULT ('events') NOT NULL, [IsDevelopment] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_DatabaseServer_IsDevelopment] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [EnvironmentLevel] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_DatabaseServer_EnvironmentLevel] DEFAULT (-1) NOT NULL, [Notes] [nvarchar](500) NULL, [Region] [varchar](250) CONSTRAINT [DF_DatabaseServer_Region] DEFAULT ('<unknown>') NOT NULL, constraint [PK_DatabaseServer] primary key clustered ( [ID] asc ) ) end

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'DatabaseServer' and COLUMN_NAME = 'ResourceGroup') begin alter table [dbo].[DatabaseServer] add [ResourceGroup] [varchar](250) NULL end
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'DatabaseServer' and COLUMN_NAME = 'ElasticPools') begin alter table [dbo].[DatabaseServer] add [ElasticPools] [varchar](2500) NULL end
changeSet.rollback:
if exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'DatabaseServer' and COLUMN_NAME = 'ResourceGroup') begin alter table [dbo].[DatabaseServer] drop column [ResourceGroup] end
if exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'DatabaseServer' and COLUMN_NAME = 'ElasticPools') begin alter table [dbo].[DatabaseServer] drop column [ElasticPools] end
